_meta.description: Dated ground photos, by the owner or by people who gave permission to use them. Entries with kind "video" are stills from a creator's ground video, shared with permission (InfraUnfiltered, owner confirmed 2026-11-10); 'date' is then the day the video was published, video_t is the second in the video, and source_url opens the video there. Each still is matched to its station by the creator's spoken station name at that point. 'stations' holds photos for each station page, keyed by the station id in stations.json. Put the image files in public/photos/ (location data removed) and add entries below. See UPDATING.md.

income-tax-office.alt: The zero-shaped steel pylon of the Shunya cable-stayed bridge in Bandra Kurla Complex, with MMRDA written across its top, against a blue sky with cranes and buildings under construction behind
income-tax-office.caption: The pylon of the Shunya bridge, which takes the line over the Vakola nallah between Income Tax Office and ILFS

income-tax-office.alt: Station frames of Income Tax Office station across the road in BKC, with a finished Line 2B pier on the right
income-tax-office.caption: The station frames. The creator says deck slabs are going in

eeh.alt: The side of EEH station's concourse and platform levels in bare concrete and brick, with the steel roof frame going up on top, above shops and a tin-roofed building
eeh.caption: The station from the street, with the roof frame going up

eeh.alt: Looking up from a lane at the underside of the EEH station viaduct on its round pier, with the station's grey concrete floors and green safety nets behind
eeh.caption: The viaduct and pier at the end of the station

eeh.alt: A man climbs a wide concrete staircase up to the EEH station building, beside green netting and coconut palms, with rubble in front
eeh.caption: The entrance stairs up to the station

eeh.alt: Beams of the EEH station from below at the junction, where the Line 2B viaduct and the station frames meet over the road
eeh.caption: The station from below. The creator says the platform deck is nearly complete

esic-nagar.alt: Girder launching work underway at Juhu Circle.
Looking up from the road at ESIC Nagar station: the platform deck on its piers, with the first steel roof arches on top and a crane boom in front
esic-nagar.caption: The station deck, with the first roof arches going up

prem-nagar.alt: Underside of the Prem Nagar station deck over the road, with a station pier and a truck parked below
prem-nagar.caption: The station deck from below. The creator says platform and finishing work is going on

indira-nagar.alt: Underside of the Indira Nagar station deck with its wide cross beams, auto rickshaws on the road and site cabins beside a pier
indira-nagar.caption: The station deck from below. The creator says platform work is going on and the roof is next

nanavati-hospital.alt: The Nanavati Hospital station deck seen from below, with a large station pier on the right and traffic beside the site barricade
nanavati-hospital.caption: The station deck from below. The creator says the roof is next

khira-nagar.alt: Underside of the Khira Nagar station deck along the road, with a blue site cabin under it
khira-nagar.caption: The creator says the platform deck is complete and the roof is next

saraswat-nagar.alt: The Saraswat Nagar station deck from below, with a scaffolded concrete structure going up on the left
saraswat-nagar.caption: The creator says the platform deck is complete and the roof is next

bandra-metro.alt: Bandra Metro station under construction at a busy junction: wide station piers with cross arms and part of the deck in place, with cars and a taxi below
bandra-metro.caption: Station piers and part of the deck. The creator says much work is still left here

ilfs.alt: Portal frames of ILFS station over the road in BKC, with reinforcement bars standing up for the deck and steel parts by the roadside
ilfs.caption: The station frames. The creator says the platform deck is not started yet

mtnl-metro.alt: The MTNL Metro station structure along the road in BKC, with its concrete side walls and wide underside
mtnl-metro.caption: The creator says the station deck is nearly complete and roof columns have started

sg-barve-marg.alt: Station portal frames of SG Barve Marg station over the road, with green netting on top and traffic below
sg-barve-marg.caption: The station frames. The creator says the platform deck is not started yet

kurla-east.alt: Kurla (E) station beside the road, with its steel roof frame on top of the station box
kurla-east.caption: The creator says the roofing work is going on

chembur.alt: Chembur station, open, from the road below, with its name board under the viaduct and a grey wall beside the road
chembur.caption: The open Chembur station, where the Phase 3 stretch ends
